title: 風景・建築の記録
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square environment illustration for a Japanese creative website's scene chooser. Complete actual illustrated scenery, refined professional background artwork with convincing depth, material texture, soft natural daylight, restrained warm-neutral colour and delicate lines. Clearly show the specified actual scene, no title-only placeholder. Large readable environment fills image, foreground/middle/background connected in consistent perspective. No people, no faces or human-shaped shadows, no artist references, no copying existing artworks, no lantern, no fantasy glow, no logos, no text/labels, no collage or multi-panel contact sheet. Exactly one finished image. Scene: A quiet Japanese hillside settlement where natural terrain and architecture form a single coherent place. In foreground an old stone retaining wall and gently curving path, middle ground a few timber houses with tiled roofs fitted into terraced slopes, grasses and trees growing around the buildings, background rolling wooded hills under a lightly cloudy daytime sky. Precise roof/window structure, observable terrain changes, plants and natural material wear. Architectural landscape record, broad view, no inhabitants.
processing: Original generated resolution kept; RGB JPEG q85 encoding only

visualQA.method: Individual review of the full generated output; file checks are separate from visual scene assessment.
visualQA.observations: 石の小道と擁壁、斜面に沿う木造瓦屋根の家、遠い森林の丘が一つの地形へ接続している。風景と建築の双方を広景で示し、人物や文字はない。
